description: Prepared with goose, onions, and carrots.
steps: Slice the onions, carrots, and lemon into pieces.
Boil them with parsley, thyme, cloves, peppercorns, and juniper berries in 1 liter of good vinegar.
Allow the mixture to cool completely.
Place the heavily bacon-interlarded goose in the cooled marinade.
Cover well and let it marinate for 3-4 days.
Roast the marinated goose in abundant butter for 3-4 hours, or braise it in butter with added onion, spices, lemon, vegetables, and abundant bacon.
Remove the fat from the sauce and take out the goose.

title: Nakládaná rajská jablíčka (Pickled Tomatoes)
description: Prepared with tomatoes and vinegar.
steps: Select ripe but not overripe tomatoes, clean them thoroughly, and place on a large plate so the water drains
Take a stone jar of about 3 gallons capacity, clean and dry it, and arrange the tomatoes in it without crushing them
Boil good vinegar and pour it hot over the tomatoes
Cover with a plate so it cools as slowly as possible
When the steam escapes, seal well and store in the cellar

title: Nakládané hovězí (Boiled Corned Beef)
description: Prepared with beef and water.
steps: Clean the meat well; if it is too salty, place it in cold water, which when it comes to a boil, after about 10 minutes, drain and replace with fresh boiling water.
If it is not too salty, you can place it in hot water.
Skim off the foam diligently and boil about half an hour for each pound of meat, so 4 pounds for about two hours.
If it is to be served cold, it is better not to remove it immediately after cooking, but rather set it aside and leave it in the water in which it was boiled until it has almost cooled.
Then place the meat in a shallow dish, lay a board over it, and weigh it down with bricks.
The compressed meat cuts better.

title: Nakládání okurek (Pickling of Cucumbers)
description: Prepared with cucumbers, vinegar, and water.
steps: Pick cucumbers in the evening and place in a bucket, covering with fresh cold water and let soak briefly
Prepare salt water so saturated that an egg floats in it
Remove cucumbers from plain water and place in salt water where they stay overnight
In the morning remove and dry with cloth, which gives them a nice green color
Pack cucumbers into a five-gallon barrel with one end removed, alternating layers of cucumbers and dill until the barrel is full
Seal the barrel
Boil water and vinegar using three-quarters of a pail of water to one-quarter pint of vinegar
Add some spices during boiling
When cooled, pour through the bung hole

title: Naložená rajská jablíčka na kyselo (Pickled Tomatoes in Vinegar)
description: Prepared with tomatoes, vinegar, and salt.
steps: Wash, dry, and salt the tomatoes
Let stand for about 4 hours
Boil good vinegar and when cooled, pour over the tomatoes and let stand until the next day
On the second day, drain the vinegar, boil it again, and when cooled pour over the tomatoes
On the third day, boil fresh vinegar
Place tomatoes in jars and pour the fresh boiled and cooled vinegar over them until the jars are about two inches from full
Stand the jars close together in water so they do not bump each other during cooking, and let them boil in steam for about five minutes
Remove jars to table, attach rubber seals, tighten lids well, and return to the same water and let cool completely
Stored this way, pickled tomatoes will keep for over two years and remain fresh even if air reaches them

Brush with beaten snow from the 4 egg yolks

title: Obyčejná hovězí polévka (Ordinary Beef Soup)
description: A soup made with beef, parsley root, and carrot.
steps: Clean everything well. Put bones in cold water, place over fire, and when water is hot, add the meat and piece of liver.
Let simmer slowly, skim the foam, salt the soup.
When meat is tender, strain the soup through fine sieve into a pot, in which you will thicken it.
The soup may also be thickened when the meat is half cooked by adding cleaned groats, torn groats, wheat groats, rice or sago, as preferred, and let them cook in the soup with the meat.
For 6 to 8 persons, one quarter pound of any thickening agent suffices, and half an hour is enough to cook it, except groats, which are cooked in fifteen minutes.
The weight of meat and quantity of water, vegetables and thickening agent should be adjusted according to the number of persons.

description: A soup made with beef, vegetables or celery or parsley root or parsley or onion or leek or cabbage or carrot or turnip or cauliflower, and peas or clove or garlic or caraway or onion or mushrooms.

steps: Rinse 2 pounds of beef in clean cold water and pound it with a wooden mallet

title: Pečený Zajíc (Roast Rabbit)

When ready to roast, remove the rabbit to a board, lard it nicely with lard, put a piece of butter on a baking pan with two fresh sliced onions, place the rabbit on it with the lard side down, add some of the liquid in which it was resting.
During roasting, turn the rabbit frequently, basting it each time with thick sour cream, and place pieces of butter on top until the rabbit browns nicely on the surface and the gravy thickens.

title: Pickling Peppered Cucumbers
description: Prepared with cucumbers, vinegar, and cherry or grape.
steps: Select healthy, firm, rather small cucumbers and the best quality clean vinegar; dilute the vinegar with soft water and add salt; to three liters of vinegar add one liter of water and six tablespoons of salt
Pickling cucumbers must be gathered dry; early cucumbers are better than late ones
Wash the cucumbers in cold water, clean and dry them, then place in glass jars or barrels

The barrels must be completely clean and without any smell; place cherry or grape leaves and dill greens at the bottom, then arrange the cucumbers well, and always add some green paprika with each layer
For each layer of cucumbers, add a layer of leaves and dill
Pour the boiled and cooled vinegar over everything, continuing layer by layer until the container is full, then seal completely so no air can enter
If the vinegar dries out, refill with new vinegar prepared the same way
Some pour a little plum brandy over the cucumbers in jars to keep them fresher and longer
It is also possible to seal them on top with fat so air cannot easily enter
For quick sour cucumbers, cut them at both ends and keep them for two or three days in a warm room, then store in a cold place
